experiment: Concurrent native M1 Mac section exports

summary.timing_boundary: Both complete MP4 files exist; source preparation and subsequent verification are excluded.
summary.cost_note: Local rendering only. R2 preparation requests, storage and electricity are separate.

live_app_control.explanation: Another workflow restarted the server before clean calibration. This experiment never restarted or swapped the live application; it yielded its own workers to the live import.

discarded_runs.reason: Extensionless staged source files made AVFoundation fall back to FFmpeg; invalid native-Mac comparisons. Downloaded sources now keep their extensions.
Stopped own workers when a live-project transcode began. Excluded.

Not chosen because slower than two workers; also failed exact Corrupt Cop decoded-audio parity. Equal decoded sample counts; difference characterized in calibration-three-audio-comparison.json, root cause not established.
External live media work began; benchmark stopped only its own renderers. Interrupted batch timings excluded; completed files preserved.
Yielded to another media process at the end of Young Actress. The interrupted batch is excluded; the first separately completed Young baseline is retained instead.

limitations: One complete baseline/candidate pair; OS file caches, thermals and other non-media work are uncontrolled.
Both configurations use the same isolated engine binary and frozen original source bytes.
Export readiness excludes source preparation and post-export quality checks.
Local timing boundary differs from the prior Modal cloud-ready metric, which included validation and publication.
No production integration in this experiment.
method.serial_baseline_method: Sum the fresh, fully completed Young Actress and Corrupt Cop individual normal exports. They were run in separate idle windows; exclude idle gaps and all interrupted work. This is the sum of measured individual export times, not an observed uninterrupted batch wall time.
method.audio_investigation_note: Three standalone audio-only repeats produced identical mixed PCM hashes and identical decoded AAC hashes, matching the unselected three-worker variant. All audio preceded picture work, so the observed earlier audio difference is independent of picture concurrency. Root cause of the two native-audio variants is not established.

mid_baseline_power_observation.note: Settings observed mid-baseline; they were not changed by the experiment.

Young Actress.note: Clip-span counts from the frozen model; stage utilization was not profiled.

Corrupt Cop.note: Clip-span counts from the frozen model; stage utilization was not profiled.

method.verification_method: Full software decode of all four complete outputs, exact frame counts and timing-grid checks, strict decoded audio hash parity, and three-frame SSIM comparisons around fourteen section joins.
method.harness_note: The archived harness is the final reproduction version. Added diagnostics, checksum assertions, fixture selection and report persistence during the experiment; rendering code, encoder settings and candidate scheduling were unchanged.

final_checks.cancel_isolation_unit: passed; unrelated peer process remains alive

cleanup.note: Only owned full-run section MP4s and interrupted-run MP4s were removed after validation. Final outputs, original source snapshots, logs, manifests and reports remain.

source_preparation.note: Preparation and corrective staging work are outside the export timers; no end-to-end preparation duration is claimed.
source_preparation.extension_fix: Preserve media extensions for AVFoundation discovery; initial extensionless calibration is invalid and excluded from comparisons.

selection.reason: Two workers were faster than three in the short timing trial; only normal and two-worker trials passed exact decoded-audio parity.
